description:
Version 2.9 carries the corrected manuscript of Dense Algebraic Loci of Hodge Classes, the journal version of hexagonmath.org 2610.00315v2, with its LaTeX source, verification programs and Lean certificate. It gives a self-contained proof that (F2) implies the Hodge conjecture for abelian varieties (Borel density for Sp(V, psi) and one push-forward from a product with X x X); proves the lemma on classes reached from abelian varieties through semisimplicity of polarisable Hodge structures; states the sixfold link at a point with the Mumford Hodge group, where 26 invariant classes are a lower bound everywhere and an equality at a very general point; writes out the genus-four Prym argument; and removes every use of an unrefereed preprint from the proofs. Version 2.9.1 corrects this archive metadata only.

F2, F3-prime and the full Hodge conjecture remain open. GitHub-related contact: egspl@proton.me.
